Elmo’s X account hacked to publish racist and
antisemitic posts
In case it wasn’t obvious, no, that’s not the real
Elmo that posted racist and antisemitic posts on
Elon Musk’s X. Someone hacked into the Sesame
Street character’s X account.
On Sunday, Elmo’s official account published
several abusive posts, since removed. It’s not clear
how the account was compromised, but the
nonprofit Sesame Workshop said it was “working to
restore full control of the account.”
The account also called on the Trump
administration to release files related to the Jeffrey
Epstein investigation, which President Trump has
sought to downplay. 
At the time of writing, Elmo’s hacked X account still
links to a Telegram channel, which in an earlier
post referenced what seemed to be a crypto scam.
It’s the latest high-profile account to have been
hacked since Musk’s takeover of the site, formerly
Twitter, in 2022, including the U.S. Securities and
Exchange Commission, OpenAI, and Donald Trump
Jr.
Musk’s AI company xAI apologized last week after
its Grok chatbot posted antisemitic memes and
expressed support for Adolf Hitler. Musk himself
performed a Nazi salute at Trump’s inauguration.
